title: Edge-case tests for a text statistics module
difficulty_rationale: Small pure-function module with a clear docstring contract; edge cases (empty input, punctuation, ties, n bounds) are listed in the docstrings.
summary: Write a pytest suite for textstats.stats that passes on the correct implementation, covers it and detects seeded faults.
required_behavior: Tests live in tests/test_stats.py and use pytest.
The suite passes against the unmodified module.
Line coverage of textstats/stats.py is at least 90%.
The suite detects (fails on) at least 80% of the hidden mutants of the module.
The module under test must not be modified.
acceptance_criteria: Submitted tests pass on the original module.
At least 6 test cases are collected.
Line coverage >= 0.90 of the target module.
Mutation score >= 0.80 on the hidden mutant set.

acceptance_tests.description: Submitted suite passes against the original module.
Line coverage of the target module >= 90%.
At least 80% of hidden mutants are killed.
